tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Nonuniqueness of Lipschitz a.e. solutions] 1. ch3:3.3.3-ex-1\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations For $u_t+|u_x|^2=0$ with $u(x,0)=0$, both $u_1\equiv 0$ and \[ u_2(x,t)= \begin{cases} 0,& |x|\ge t,\\ x-t,& 0\le x\le t,\\ -x-t,& -t\le x\le 0, \end{cases} \] are Lipschitz a.e. solutions. Thus the a.e. notion alone is nonunique. \end{example}
